text:
## Creative brief
Plan a ~60-second documentary about Viviana’s book Playful Pottery and what is an important lesson about creativity and kindness the book aims to show.

## Overview & Tone

This 60-second profile is built around a journey from isolation to tactile, joyful expression. We open with stark, introspective restraint to let Viviana’s reflection on modern overconsumption land with immediate weight, then bloom into warm acoustic textures and vibrant studio energy as she introduces *Playful Pottery*. The cutting pace accelerates through hands-on shaping and glazing sequences, emphasizing rhythm and tactile imperfection over rigid polish, before resolving into an uplifting, meditative takeaway about self-kindness and creative freedom.

---

## Story Beats

#### 1. Hook & The Ceramics Surge (0:00–0:12) [node: beat_b88a0ecd-3ddd-4411-b46c-ce14fcd70eea]

We open cold on complete visual and auditory silence with a solid black frame [node: card_9dcf3fad-a83a-44b3-91ed-b30912677de3] as Viviana’s voiceover breaks in cleanly: *"I think that it's so easy to desire so many things that we actually don't need"* [node: card_259b686c-7b63-4102-87e3-d12e0dce0595]. The dialogue is tightly cut from `A001C004_240718BC` (26.2s–28.5s) [node: card_8e5ebfc3-2e7e-4489-bfcd-6f74ffda8fae] (A001C004_240718BC (26.2s–28.5s)), eliminating any vocal hesitation so the proposition lands with clarity.

At 0:03, we hard-cut abruptly from black into the physical reality of the studio as she continues her thought: *"with lockdown, people really sat in their houses and realized that the things that were surrounding them weren't bringing them joy. And I think that's why ceramics has had such a big surge"* [node: card_c9daf269-e8fc-4935-84e3-d54bd069c630], sourced from `A001C004_240718BC` (30s–37.6s) [node: card_5b597400-c99d-4042-9ec1-9565bd045861] (A001C004_240718BC (30s–37.6s)) with breaths and pauses tightened for forward momentum. Over this continuation, we establish the atmosphere with evocative studio coverage in `B003C007_240719CC` [node: card_51b283e4-cba7-4b30-8056-fd53dec80fe6] (B003C007_240719CC (2.2s–7.2s)), cutting on motion into a trimmed, punchy section of `B003C061_240719AN` [node: card_bcda68ff-53a2-4361-9bdd-085924b87b42] (B003C061_240719AN (19.1s–24.8s)) to show clay being prepped, establishing the physical craft right as she mentions the ceramics revival.

#### 2. Introduction & Playful Pottery (0:12–0:28) [node: beat_7fa5caaa-6ead-4926-a3d3-9f5c043a8c67]

At 0:12, we introduce the acoustic guitar cue `calm_ambient.wav` [node: card_3f02b288-0afb-45b9-be4e-2c2a1b716638] (projects/mudwitch-documentary/sound/calm_ambient.wav (use 132.2s–168.4s of the source — real stock audio file, use directly, do not generate a replacement)), lifting the energy to warm, optimistic storytelling as Viviana begins talking about her book [node: card_36fd7ef6-0210-47b7-bcf0-673295be06f5]. We cut on-camera to an intimate interview setup where Viviana introduces herself and unpacks her creative background [node: card_4f2dc757-74ba-4e90-a3e1-91551b68f0b4] [node: card_0bed349e-ca31-4d0b-a6f3-0a481160ed0c].

Her dialogue is structured using the paired selections in group [node: card_6638ae07-a446-4995-aee2-0ba8708e91f2] (A001C004_240718BC (98s–107.6s); A001C004_240718BC (119.8s–130.5s)): `A001C004_240718BC` (98s–107.6s) establishes her authorship, transitioning seamlessly into a trimmed selection of `A001C004_240718BC` (119.8s–130.5s) where she articulates the book’s core purpose [node: card_beca0fe8-9010-4180-a002-d7f9fcfebd72]. As her explanation deepens around 0:20, we cut away from the talking head to colorful finished ceramics and close-ups of *Playful Pottery* [node: card_3f81c359-76f7-4c30-8e8b-5ae67290af8e], anchoring the visual narrative on the detail shot `B003C028_240719CX` (11.3s–13.6s) [node: card_c574b609-25b8-4e42-bc3a-379f1aa2615f] (B003C028_240719CX (11.3s–13.6s)) before carrying the motion directly into the next beat.

#### 3. Creativity, Kindness & Tactile Joy (0:28–0:44) [node: beat_8185ca87-bdc9-4875-8ac7-837edb37e88b]

This beat dives straight into the emotional thesis of the book: hands-on craft as a practice of patience, kindness, and intuition [node: card_6fca4938-4c10-457e-8a04-38e7aa184db8]. Viviana’s voiceover from `A001C004_240718BC` (1140.9s–1150.9s) [node: card_51a27f75-b9d4-4941-8e82-97e270b6d13a] (A001C004_240718BC (1140.9s–1150.9s)) drives this sequence, edited to remove filler pauses and emphasize process over perfection [node: card_5ac04f92-7f09-4a8b-86ff-8e2fd9a090dd], while the acoustic bed [node: card_3f02b288-0afb-45b9-be4e-2c2a1b716638] (projects/mudwitch-documentary/sound/calm_ambient.wav (use 132.2s–168.4s of the source — real stock audio file, use directly, do not generate a replacement)) sustains a gentle momentum underneath.

Visually, we drive the narrative through a rhythmic montage of hand movements and shaping techniques [node: card_97635463-9148-4049-8371-12dc0402283d], curated from B-roll group [node: card_c98a2a4c-9e6f-4571-9846-24d991d358c4] (B003C011_240719YX (21.3s–37.9s); B003C006_240719KM (84.3s–95s); B003C008_240719QA (139s–164s); B003C006_240719KM (157.5s–166.6s); B003C006_240719KM (56.9s–64.8s); B003C006_240719KM (32s–39s); B003C005_240719NB (0.8s–13.5s)). We lead with the visceral wheel-throwing contact in `B003C011_240719YX` (trimmed to highlight the initial pull) and `B003C006_240719KM` (84.3s–95s, centering on palm pressure). We intercut dynamic tool passes from `B003C006_240719KM` (32s–39s and 56.9s–64.8s) and the expressive sculpting action in `B003C005_240719NB`. We reserve `B003C008_240719QA` (139s–164s) and `B003C006_240719KM` (157.5s–166.6s) as secondary cutaways or trimming alternatives to avoid visual repetition and maintain a tight, brisk montage cadence.

#### 4. Spontaneity & Growth (0:44–1:00) [node: beat_86a9f85d-0e5b-4bce-9fe2-935e9c0c526c]

The finale crystallizes the book's core philosophy—releasing rigid artistic expectations and embracing organic flow [node: card_14b95b7f-df5d-42c4-8a13-5269765d8e6c] [node: card_c8b7c037-d7f6-437a-80de-30fa37c4cd95]. Viviana’s voiceover from `A001C004_240718BC` (501.63s–521.31s) [node: card_513a3f74-7ae8-46a2-927e-4a0a997e1899] (A001C004_240718BC (501.63s–521.31s)) is tightened to deliver her concluding takeaway on creative freedom: *"...just letting yourself adjust, grow whatever ideas..."* [node: card_e5dd9119-876c-4262-9092-143ff70d3799].

Over her voice, we assemble a playful sequence of finishing and glazing from group [node: card_578dd08f-1ca3-44fa-981b-9e4bdf5a7add] (B003C050_240719XK (9.6s–14.2s); B003C006_240719KM (42.6s–52.4s); B003C008_240719QA (305.42s–318.74s); B003C008_240719QA (254.38s–268.04s); B003C039_240719DU (7.9s–9.8s); B003C028_240719CX (41.2s–44.5s)). We begin with tactile glazing passes from `B003C050_240719XK` and quick studio brushwork from `B003C039_240719DU` and `B003C028_240719CX` (41.2s–44.5s). To maintain clean audio pacing under the music bed [node: card_3f02b288-0afb-45b9-be4e-2c2a1b716638] (projects/mudwitch-documentary/sound/calm_ambient.wav (use 132.2s–168.4s of the source — real stock audio file, use directly, do not generate a replacement)), we let Viviana’s primary VO carry the scene while keeping the candid sync dialogue in `B003C008_240719QA` (254.38s–268.04s and 305.42s–318.74s) down in the mix or purely visual as playful moments, using `B003C006_240719KM` (42.6s–52.4s) as an alternate trimming bridge.

At 0:56, as her dialogue concludes and the acoustic track rings out, the edit settles on a warm, static hero shot of a finished ceramic vessel [node: card_215004d0-aabb-41fb-97af-1c4ffa15cc69], letting the image linger for a moment of quiet accomplishment before fading gently to black.

## Constraints

- The plan above is the spec — it already made the editorial calls (what to use, what to omit, how to sequence and combine material). Follow the plan's own decisions rather than independently re-deriving them from first principles.
- Track is authoritative for whatever the plan places on a given track. A shot the plan describes as A-Roll must land on the A-Roll track, B-Roll on B-Roll, music on the Music track, and text/graphics on the Text/Graphics track. A card does not count as fulfilled merely because related material appears elsewhere in the timeline on the wrong track.
- Timecodes and durations in the plan are approximate targets, not exact requirements — use editorial judgment on the actual cut points, same as any real edit.
- A Music card whose source names a real file path (marked "real stock audio file") must be added directly with `edit-timeline add-clip <path> --row music --role music` — do not call `/generate music` for it.

## Instructions for tagging

When adding a clip with `edit-timeline add-clip`, attach the corresponding plan node ID using `--node-ids card_<id>` (or `beat_<id>` for a beat-level marker).

If one clip fulfills multiple plan node ids, include all applicable ones.

Only attach a node ID when the clip actually fulfills what the plan describes for it, including its named track. Use the exact node IDs from the plan. Do not invent or modify them.

## Completion requirements

Before finishing, verify against the plan's own decisions, not the original grid.

For each beat, confirm the edit the plan describes was actually realized: the right material landed on the right track, in the intended order, with any transitions/overlaps the plan called out.

For any node id the plan itself named as an intentionally unused alternative or backup, no further action is needed — that was already the plan's own decision, not something to silently reconsider or silently include anyway.

A node id that the plan actively describes using, but that never lands on the corresponding clip, is a real gap — note it and the reason in verification.
